title: Spectator mode: delayed revelation
description: Spectators see public state. But some games have delayed revelation for spectators (poker tournament broadcast delay, preventing ghosting in competitive play). Does the schema express this? Is it a server/transport concern? Probably needs a simple delay_sec field on spectator visibility, but the interaction with the visibility model needs thought.
close_reason: Server policy. Room config sets spectator_delay_seconds. Visibility model already handles what spectators see (public only). Server buffers updates before forwarding to spectator connections.
